name: personal-os
description: Personal OS: one platform, eight managers, one AI Chief of Staff.

scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:generate: cd backend && uv run python -m app.scripts.export_openapi ../packages/api-client/openapi.json && cd .. && pnpm --filter @personal-os/api-client generate
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && cd backend && uv run mypy app
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && cd backend && uv run pytest
